correctness.rationale: The exact forty-facet presentation gives face vector (11,51,80,40) and only four missing edges. Exact mod-two reduction proves H1 over F2 has dimension one and that all 55 nonfacial triangular cycles are nonzero. An independent integral lattice certificate exhibits a determinant-two sublattice of facial boundaries; combined with the nonzero mod-two quotient this proves H1 over Z is exactly Z/2. The standard-library verifier exhausts all 17,280 degree-block-preserving permutations, recovers 48 automorphisms, and computes the complete five-orbit systolic partition.

value.rationale: The unique vertex-and-facet-minimal triangulation of RP3 is a canonical extremal model, and its only nonzero integral H1 class is the fundamental torsion loop type. Classifying every shortest simplicial carrier of that torsion class is therefore a natural combinatorial systolic invariant. The five symmetry orbits add structural information beyond a raw count by tying the shortest layer to the 6+4+1 vertex-orbit stratification.
